absences: No HALEU or enrichment contract, DOE fuel award, or loan dated 2026-10-28 to 2026-10-30 surfaced in 10 searches. Items are empty for that reason. The newest fuel items found (Centrus $900M, General Matter DOE IDIQ, DOE third HALEU round 2026-07-23) are already in skip/news.json.

No microreactor conditional commitment or loan from the Office of Energy Dominance Financing (formerly LPO) in Oct 2026. The June 2026 $17.5B nuclear loan action covers AP1000 reactors, not microreactors.
Antares $470M Series C (closed sometime in 2026, exact date not confirmed) was seen in search only. Not written as an item: no dated primary source fetched.

OBBBA nuclear clause not verified against statute text. govinfo PL 119-21 fetches reached Sec. 70512-70513 (wind and solar terms) but not the nuclear begin-construction deadline or the nuclear energy community 10% adder; congress.gov returned 403. The skip's 2034 date and three-year phase-out remain unchecked.

Alaska: only the FY2027 proposal (22.11 cents/kWh, notice 2026-05-01) was found. No final FY2027 order or appendix was located, so the per-utility $0.41-$1.95/kWh figures are not re-checked against a newer order.

HALEU and TRISO price points, DOE allocation quantities, enrichment contract values, insurance and staffing: no shipped figure for these exists in skip/costs.json (only a HALEU mention in the incentives text), so nothing was checked.

INL LMTR-20 capex and LCOE bands, NEI FOAK range, and the U-Michigan $48-78/MWh band: not re-searched this pass. No newer primary source was seen for them, and the NEI and INL reports are older than 60 days, so they could not support a confirmation.

checks.claim: The Regulatory Commission of Alaska's FY2024 Power Cost Equalization order is the definitive price sheet
checks.evidence: The RCA's notice dated 2026-05-01 (docket U-26-010, comments due 2026-06-01) proposes a FY2027 PCE base amount of 22.11 cents/kWh. The FY2024 order (base 19.35 cents/kWh, set 2023-06-13) is therefore no longer the current price basis. The proposal is not final; no FY2027 order was found.
